_comment: Snowy village petshop spawns. Used by: snowy_igloo AND christmas (merged per user instruction). Winter-themed pets. All cage markers in this biome roll against this same weighted list; only the per-cage spawn count varies (cage_0/2: 1-2, cage_1: 2-3, cage_3: 1).
_schema: Schema: each entry needs {entity, weight}. Add "is_baby": false to spawn an adult instead of a baby (is_baby defaults to true — baby = bred-style age -24000 ticks, externally tunable via growth-rate mods). Edit this file in your datapack at data/ctov/petshop_spawns/<profile>.json to override the jar's built-in version.
